title: Opt .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md distribution into the opum-lore marketplace plugin
description: Remaining upstream slice split from LCLI-442 (its finalSummary explicitly scopes this out: lore init/agents still write .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md per repo rather than pointing at the opum-lore marketplace plugin, LCLI-441). Adds an explicit opt-in, [agents].skill_source in .lore/config.toml (repo|plugin, default repo unchanged), and a lore init --skill-source <repo|plugin> flag to persist it. Under skill_source=plugin, a bare lore agents/lore agents --check stops writing or proposing .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md and instead flags a leftover one as drift (orphaned, exit 6 under --check), removable only via --force and only when its bytes exactly match lore's own generated content. An explicit scoped lore init --claude/--agents request always still materializes the file regardless of this config (explicit beats config).

acceptanceCriteria.text: lore init --skill-source <repo|plugin> persists [agents].skill_source in .lore/config.toml without prompting, rejecting an unsupported value
with no skill_source configured (or skill_source=repo), lore agents/lore init behavior is byte-for-byte unchanged from before this task
under skill_source=plugin, a bare lore agents never creates SKILL.md, and lore agents --check on a leftover SKILL.md reports it orphaned and exits 6 naming the file and the remedy
lore agents --force removes an orphaned SKILL.md only when its bytes exactly match the generated doc; a hand-edited/differing leftover is left in place even under --force
an explicit lore init --claude/--agents request still materializes SKILL.md under skill_source=plugin (explicit beats config)
CHANGELOG.md documents both the new config key and the new drift/removal behavior
